title: helenium incisum
intro: Helenium incisum, commonly known as Common Sneezeweed or Yellow Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues such as congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Helenium incisum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also make it useful for treating conditions such as allergies, colds, and flu, as well as its potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties.
